The stone garden is a quiet place, where you can meditate and let time pass if you want to wait for a specific [[days|day]]. It is located directly northwest of [[Sweet Home|your home]]. In order to use it, you first have to build it.

==Crafting==
Just click on the sign northwest of [[Sweet Home|your home]].

==Usage==
Just hit "E" to enter the stone garden and start meditating. You will slowly gain {{energy}} while doing so. To quit, hit "E" again. Compared to sleeping, the gain of {{energy}} is slower, but meditation doesn't stop even if you are fully rested.

A full day passes every 45 seconds.

'''Note:''' Your game will '''not''' be saved here.
